newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia wins major Philippine GSM expansion.
newsitem.headline: Nokia wins major Philippine GSM expansion.

text.p: Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy said in a statement on Friday it had won a major digital GSM network expansion order in the Philippines from Globe Telecom.
"Globe Telecom and Nokia have signed an agreement for a major expansion of Globe's GSM network capacity and coverage," it said, but gave no financial details.
Nokia will supply mobile switch upgrades, base stations and microwave radios for base station access, it said, adding the deal followed three earlier deliveries to Globe Telecom.
"Nokia also supplied phases one, two and three of Globe Telecom's GSM network in the Philippines," it said.
Globe Telecom is one of the major full telecom service providers in the Philippines, operating both cellular and fixed networks, including the country's biggest cellular network, Nokia said.
Globe's main shareholders are Ayala Corporation and Singapore Telecom, Nokia said.
